conversation:
Priya Nair: FYI saw a 503 wave hitting hosted-inference-eu at ~01:15 UTC, lots of customer errors and increased P50. Opening a quick war room.
Alex Kim: on it, am pulling ingress logs now.
Jordan Li: tagging @OpsBot to grab recent deploys + autoscaler events :eyes:  
OpsBot: deploys: no prod deploys in the last 2h; autoscaler: scaled up gpu-pool-eu by 4 nodes at 01:09 UTC; scaled down at 01:14 UTC.
Maya Patel: customers reporting streaming session timeouts specifically after ~10s of inactivity.
Samira Gomez: stack traces show upstream 502/504 on sidecar-proxy for RL runtime, example: ```[2026-03-10T01:14:56Z] sidecar-proxy error: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. code=503```.
Alex Kim: seeing TCP FIN/RESET from keepalive on a bunch of connections to runtime. Correlation with nodes that were just added by autoscaler.
Jordan Li: hypothesis: new nodes joining + sidecar warmup/healthcheck timing causing transient rejects, clients throwing 503 to gateway.
Priya Nair: mitigation idea: pause autoscaler, re-enable healthy node warmup path, and route traffic away from newest nodes. Can we pin traffic?
Maya Patel: can do for hosted-inference-eu: set routing weight to avoid pool-eu-new until warm. Will enact now.
Alex Kim: paused autoscaler, updated LB weights to 0 for recent instances. Early sign: 503 rate dropping in the metrics. :thumbsup:
Samira Gomez: applying temporary circuit-breaker config at gateway to failfast to a stable fallback model variant to reduce downstream load. Config snippet applied: ```circuit_breaker: {requests: 50, interval_ms: 10000, reset_ms: 30000}```
Jordan Li: confirm logs: 503s down 80% in last 3m, p95 latency back to baseline. Good containment.
Priya Nair: root cause likely autoscaler + sidecar warmup race + keepalive resets from CNI overlay. Need concrete action items for postmortem.
Alex Kim: short-term followups: 1) revert autoscaler warmup to sequential join (owner: Alex, ETA: 48h) 2) add healthcheck backoffs for sidecar init (owner: Jordan, ETA: 72h).
Maya Patel: product/ops followups: 1) routing policy to avoid new nodes for 2min (owner: Maya, ETA: 24h) 2) customer comms draft for impacted tenants (owner: Priya, ETA: 6h).
Samira Gomez: infra followups: 1) tune keepalive + TCP timeout at host/proxy (owner: Samira, ETA: 1 week) 2) add alert for autoscaler churn spikes (owner: Samira, ETA: 48h).
Jordan Li: test plan: repro in canary by forcing simultaneous node joins + traffic flood with streaming sessions. Will run on staging tomorrow.
OpsBot: created incident ticket IR-2026-310 with severity=P2 and linked to this thread.
Priya Nair: adding action items to postmortem doc and scheduling follow-up retro on Mon. Thx all for quick containment.
Alex Kim: one more note — billing/ratelimit proxies also returned 429s for a handful of customers during the spike; we'll trace logs in the AM.
Maya Patel: flagged priority customers for handoff to Support (list attached in the incident ticket).
Samira Gomez: saved relevant logs to s3://redwood-incidents/3241598765/ and added links to the ticket.
Priya Nair: postmortem owners: Alex (technical root cause), Samira (infra), Maya (ops & customer comms). We should include timeline, mitigations, and proposed config changes.
Jordan Li: + include a short playbook: if autoscaler scales >3 nodes in 2m, auto-roll traffic to fallback variant and alert pager.
Alex Kim: agree. Also propose a small runtime patch to accept connections during warmup rather than reject — will draft a PR.
Priya Nair: OK closing war room. Will move this thread into postmortem channel and start the doc. If anything else shows up ping here. :white_check_mark:
